invariants.rationale: Method returns a non-null HoodieWriteMetadata object as per typical contract.
A valid HoodieWriteMetadata should contain a non-null list of WriteStatus.
Method is declared to return HoodieWriteMetadata<List<WriteStatus>>, so the WriteStatuses should be of type List.
instantTime is required for commit actions so is expected to be non-null.
A valid execution context must be provided for the operation.
